=== OIDC discovery ===
{"issuer":"http://keycloak.workspace.localhost/realms/swcode","authorization_endpoint":"http://keycloak.workspace.localhost/realms/swcode/protocol/openid-connect/auth","token_endpoint":"http://keycloak.workspace.localhost/realms/swcode/protocol/openid-connect/token","introspection_endpoint":"http://keycloak.workspace.localhost/realms/swcode/protocol/openid-connect/token/introspect","userinfo_endpoint":"http://keycloak.workspace.localhost/realms/swcode/protocol/openid-connect/userinfo","end_session_endpoint":"http://keycloak.workspace.localhost/realms/swcode/protocol/openid-connect/logout","fro
=== certs endpoint ===
200
=== login page ===

observation.command: echo '=== OIDC discovery ==='; curl -s -H 'Host: keycloak.workspace.localhost' --max-time 20 http://127.0.0.1:80/realms/swcode/.well-known/openid-configuration | head -c 600; echo; echo '=== certs endpoint ==='; curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' -H 'Host: keycloak.workspace.localhost' --max-time 20 http://127.0.0.1:80/realms/swcode/protocol/openid-connect/certs; echo '=== login page ==='; curl -s -H 'Host: keycloak.workspace.localhost' --max-time 20 http://127.0.0.1:80/realms/swcode/protocol/openid-connect/auth?client_id=urbo&redirect_uri=http://app.workspace.localhost/ | grep -oE '<title>[^<]*' | head -1
